risk_note: F1-08be (orchestrator D10-1886 S3, queue D10-1912 / D10-1935). PayoutPause.tsx send(): a failed kill-switch list read on retry (PUT not yet sent) no longer clears the 'previous PUT result unknown' mark; the mark is only changed when the PUT was sent (network / 5xx set it, definite failures clear it). Effect: after an undetermined PUT, a failed re-read, then a re-read showing the target value, the notice is 'applied earlier' instead of 'changed by someone else'; no extra write request either way. One file, no text or contract change. Rule tests by Codex (ledger tester codex, D10-1872), spec-test r1 by an independent Claude, pass. Implementation by Opus 5.5 (another context). Written by hand.
